content.ENG:
## Syntax

The _syntax_ of a programming language determines how the code of a program should be written...
content.CAS:
## Sintaxis

La _sintaxis_ de un lenguaje de programación determina cómo debe escribirse el código de un programa...
content.EUS:
## Sintaxia

Programazio-lengoaia baten _sintaxiak_ zehazten du nola idatzi behar den programa baten kodea...

description.ENG: The following program contains a syntax error. Please fix it.
description.CAS: El siguiente programa contiene un error de sintaxis. Por favor, corrígelo.
description.EUS: Hurrengo programak sintaxi errorea du. Mesedez konpondu ezazu.

initialCode.ENG:
number = int(input('Please type in a number: '}}
if number > 100
    print('The number was greater than one hundred')
    number = number - 100
    print('Now its value has decreased by one hundred')

print(f'Its value is now {number}')
initialCode.CAS:
number = int(input('Por favor, escribe un número: '}}
if number > 100
    print('The number was greater than one hundred')
    number = number - 100
    print('Now its value has decreased by one hundred')

print(f'Its value is now {number}')
initialCode.EUS:
number = int(input('Mesedez, idatzi zenbaki bat: '}}
if number > 100
    print('The number was greater than one hundred')
    number = number - 100
    print('Now its value has decreased by one hundred')

print(f'Its value is now {number}')

blocks.testCode:
import unittest
class TestSyntax(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_run(self):
        out = run_student_code(inputs=['150'])
        self.assertIn('value is now 50', out, 'Should subtract 100 | Debería restar 100 | 100 kendu beharko luke')
        out2 = run_student_code(inputs=['10'])
        self.assertIn('value is now 10', out2, 'Should not change | No debería cambiar | Ez luke aldatu behar')

content.ENG:
## Debugging

If the syntax of the program is correct but the program still doesn't function as intended...

## Depuración

Si la sintaxis del programa es correcta pero el programa no funciona como se esperaba...
content.EUS:
## Arazketa

Programaren sintaxia zuzena bada baina programak ez badu espero bezala funtzionatzen...
